answer_1.quote: In this paper, we tackle Sign Language Translation (SLT), focusing on converting sign videos into spoken language sentences.
answer_1.outputs: translations from sign language to spoken language

answer_2.quote: We report BLEU via Sacre-BLEU and ROUGE-L. BLEU-n assesses translation precision by evaluating n-grams. ROUGE-L measures text similarity by calculating the F1 score based on the longest common subsequences between predicted and reference texts. We also report BLEURT from the BLEURT-20 checkpoint, which has been shown to correlate well with human judgments.
